howto.what: Claude 每次 Read、Edit、Bash 都会变成一条压缩观察记录,会话结束时汇总;相关的记录会自动注入后续提示,让下一个会话带着上一次的上下文开始,不必重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 同一项目里的第二次会话起开始自动注入记忆,首次会话只负责为项目播种记忆。也可运行 /learn-codebase 把整个仓库一次性载入记忆(约 5 分钟,可选)。

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit, and Bash Claude makes becomes a compressed observation, summarized at session end. Relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts so the next session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection starts on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory. Running /learn-codebase front-loads the whole repo in one pass (~5 minutes, optional).

say_en.note: Everything stays in ~/.claude-mem on this machine
